definitions.gloss: to stop, to come to a halt
definitions.explanation: Used when something stops moving or functioning. This is an intransitive verb—the action happens on its own.

examples.japanese: バスが{止|と}まりました。
{時計|とけい}が{止|と}まっている。

examples.notes: Can also be written 止んだ (yanda) for rain

notes: 止まる is an intransitive verb meaning 'to stop.' The transitive pair is 止める (tomeru, to stop something). Also note 泊まる (tomaru, to stay overnight) is a different word with the same reading. Conjugation: 止まらない (negative), 止まります (polite), 止まった (past).
